messages.subject: [Tester] Need the volunteer who can help to fix the installation issue of external tool issue from Skyline.
parts:
Dear MSstats users,

Last week, we found that lots of computers which have different base language (not English, and most of them are from Europe so far.) have installation issue of MSstats external tool in Skyline. In order to solve this issue, we need some volunteers :

1. who already tried to install MSstats external tool in Skyline, but has any issue from any one of three functionalities.
2. who has the computer with different base language.
3. who has all authorization in your computer.
4. who can work with me remotely for some hours.

If you are interested in, please contact us or post here.
Thank you.

Sincerely,
- Meena
